scope: One conflict-free 3D Coulomb color, prepared Rust tiles, one or more ordered solve passes
tolerance_reason: f32 arithmetic with differing CPU/GPU contraction and quaternion evaluation; checked per output after up to three sequential passes
preconditions: no velocity slot shared by two active manifolds
invariants: friction inside Coulomb disk when enabled

known_gaps.description: Rust host SIMD and scalar/GPU quaternion transforms can round to opposite sides of distance == 0, selecting different CFM branches. Portable suite tests exact zero without rotated-point cancellation; replay --boundary-stress preserves the adversarial case. A cross-backend numerical policy is unresolved.
